## Build, watch or play

From this directory, run `./build.sh`, then `./watch.sh`. Use `./watch.sh --verify-only` for a verification without opening the player. Where a starting save is retained, `./play.sh --label "My attempt"` records an alternative human continuation and adds it to this report. Historical cases lacking a recording/save explain that limit instead of inventing playback.

## Evaluation and diagnosis

See the [overall assessment](overall-assessment.md). It covers three Deep Descent reads
(town → DL7, DL4 → DL13, DL13 → DL18 at CL10), the Dagger wielded in place of the Maul when
the warrior arrived on DL13, and eight known Cure Light Wounds that the CL10 healing tier
made unusable. There were also nine unidentified Cure Serious Wounds, and no town visit for
about 63k turns. These are source-checked mechanisms with native evidence. No reusable
original-C defect or rescue is established.
